Case :- Criminal Misc. Writ Petition No. - 5728 of 2023

entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad

sentences.text:
Respondent :- State Of U.P. And 3 Others
Counsel for Petitioner :- Diwan Saifullah Khan,Mohd Harish

Counsel for Respondent :- G.A.
Hon'ble Vivek Kumar Birla,J.
Hon'ble Surendra Singh-I,J.
Heard Sri Arjun Singh Solanki, holding brief of Sri D.S. Khan, learned counsel for the petitioner and Sri Ratan Singh, learned A.G.A for the State respondents.

The relief sought in this petition is for quashing of the F.I.R. dated 16.8.2021, registered as Case Crime No. 204 of 2021, under Sections 411, 413, 414, 419, 420 IPC, Police Station Bahariya, District Prayagraj.
Further prayer has been made not to arrest the petitioner in the aforesaid case.

Submission of the learned counsel for the petitioner is that the petitioner has been falsely implicated in the present case, inasmuch as he was detained in Central Jail, Naini pursuant to the remand order dated 15.8.2021 and was released on 18.8.2021 and therefore, no offence has been made out and the implication of the petitioner in the crime is false.

sentences.text: Learned AGA opposed the prayer for quashing of the FIR, which discloses cognizable offence.
He next submits that except the petitioner against whom the investigation is pending, a charge-sheet no. 216 of 2021 dated 10.10.2021 has been filed against all other accused persons.

He pointed out that Gangster Act has also been imposed on the petitioner and the detention of the petitioner in Jail on the date of incident is of no consequence in view of the allegation as made in the first information report.
Learned AGA also pointed out that the petitioner is absconding and investigation is pending.

We have gone through the first information report and we find that allegation against the petitioner is that he was involved in the sale and purchase of the property and therefore, submission of the learned counsel for petitioner is immaterial.
Perusal of the impugned first information report prima facie also reveals commission of cognizable offence.

Therefore, in view of the law laid down by Hon'ble Supreme Court in the case of State of Haryana and others vs. Bhajan Lal and others, 1992 Supp. (1) SCC 335 and M/s Neeharika Infrastructure Pvt.
Ltd. vs. State of Maharashtra, AIR 2021 SC 1918 and in Special Leave to Appeal (Crl.) No.3262/2021 (Leelavati Devi @ Leelawati & another vs. the State of Uttar Pradesh) decided on 07.10.2021, no case has been made out for interference with the impugned first information report.
